name: 标准话术模板随机抽取器

map.标准话术模板随机抽取器是做什么的？: What does Service Script Sampler do?
map.如何使用标准话术模板随机抽取器？: How do I use Service Script Sampler?
map.标准话术模板随机抽取器适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Service Script Sampler best for?
map.随机抽取按设定数量去重：从模板库抽取 n 条时，候选数 = 库内总条数，可选组合: Random sampling takes a set count with de-duplication: drawing n items from the template library gives combinations equal to n-of-total; results are sorted by category or difficulty for practice; coverage = drawn items / total items x 100%. For customer-service training, draw 5-10 items each time and record how well the drawn items are mastered to track training progress.
map.客服晨会抽 3 条标准话术做开场演练，避免每天练同一套形成表达定式。: In the morning huddle, draw 3 standard scripts for a warm-up drill to avoid repeating the same set daily and forming a fixed phrasing habit.
map.新人培训随机抽题做即兴应答，检验是否真正掌握话术而不是背顺序。: In new-hire training, randomly draw items for impromptu responses to check real mastery of the scripts rather than rote ordering.
map.质检抽查随机选模板比对录音文本，看坐席是否使用了合规表述。: For QA spot checks, randomly pick templates to compare against call transcripts and see whether agents used compliant wording.
map.设定生成数量 3，从内置话术库抽出问候、致歉、结束语各一条；连续 5 天抽到的组: Setting the count to 3 draws one greeting, one apology and one closing line from the built-in library; over 5 consecutive days the combinations barely repeat, giving clearly better coverage than practising in a fixed order.
map.抽到重复条目怎么处理: What if a duplicate item is drawn
map.话术库条目有限且每次抽取相互独立，小库容配大数量时重复概率上升；需要不重复时把数: The library is limited and each draw is independent, so a small library with a large count raises the repeat probability; to avoid repeats, set the count below the library size and draw in batches, or de-duplicate manually before distributing.
map.页面用随机比较器排序后取前 N 条实现抽取，取到每条的概率并不严格相等；日常练习: The page draws by sorting with a random comparator and taking the first N, so the probability per item is not strictly equal; fine for daily practice but unsuitable for formal lotteries that require equal probability.
map.为什么有时抽到重复条目？: Why is a duplicate item sometimes drawn?
map.每次抽取相互独立、不排除已抽过的条目，因此小库容配大数量时重复概率上升；请分批抽: Each draw is independent and does not exclude previously drawn items, so a small library with a large count raises the repeat probability; draw in batches or de-duplicate manually.
map.话术库能自定义吗？: Can the script library be customised?
map.当前使用页面内置的通用标准话术库，暂不支持导入自定义话术；可先在本工具中挑出骨架: It currently uses the built-in generic standard script library and does not yet support importing custom scripts; pick a skeleton in this tool first, then replace it with your own business wording.
